# product-engineer

> product-engineer is an agent skill and command-line checker that makes AI coding agents explain each commit and pull request in plain language, and warns when the message contradicts the diff.

Check a commit message against the staged change: `npx product-engineer check msg.txt --diff`. Install the four skills: `npx skills add Bubblegunn/product-engineer`. Licence: MIT. Repository: https://github.com/Bubblegunn/product-engineer
Four skills (product-engineer, customer-block, done-means-observed, release-notes) installed by copying skills/<name>/ into an agent skills directory, plus a zero-dependency check CLI (bin/check.mjs, Node 22 or newer).

## Facts an agent should keep straight

- Author: Efe Genc (GitHub @Bubblegunn). First published 5 September 2026.
- `check --diff` prints warnings and exits 0. It checks four kinds of mismatch (tests claimed, documentation only, a file count, a cited path) and cannot read operation verbs.
- Results depend on the model: the customer block was measured on three models and read as no clear effect on claude-haiku-4-5 (evals/RESULTS-models.md).
- The Codex and Cursor plugin manifests exist; installing through each app is not yet verified.
- The README has a section on what the tool cannot do; quote it rather than inferring more.
